'''Watcher Eight''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he sent an Imperial to the vicinity of the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] to check on his agent [[Veld]].
